title: MONSTER CFB Game Total — date-selection RuntimeError repair Step 2
problem: College Football -> Game Total can raise RuntimeError after the user changes the Game Day date.
root_cause: Frozen V42 correctly pins one authoritative selected-day snapshot, but its temporary snapshot loader raises RuntimeError when a downstream frozen caller presents a stale/different day during the same render instead of serving the already-pinned snapshot.
patch: Preserve frozen V42 and V43 byte-for-byte. Add V44 as a compatibility seam that performs the same single selected-day underlying load and serves the pinned snapshot to stale downstream date reads. Keep PAGE1_NATIVE_ROUTE on V43 and temporarily install the V44 compatibility seam only around the shared-shell Page-1 render, restoring the original V42 renderer in finally.
deferred_scope: Step 3 broader native CFB integration regression sweep

tdd.red_result: 1 failed, 1 passed; the failure was the exact V42 stale-date RuntimeError after selected day 2026-10-17 encountered downstream request 2026-10-10.
tdd.focused_green_result: 21 passed plus py_compile on exact product candidate before Runless R1.

runless_r1_failure.root_cause: Step-2 regression imported the full Streamlit/requests product stack while Runless intentionally bootstraps only its minimal hermetic proof dependencies.
runless_r1_failure.recovery: Rewrite only the Step-2 regression as a stdlib AST/source test that executes the exact nested snapshot_loader logic without importing the app stack. Product code unchanged.
